programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Shipping Cattle. With the family working on the farm, Ree whips up a well-deserved breakfast. She makes sweet and savoury pancakes and for dinner she makes braised short ribs. S9, Ep13

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 16-Minute Meals: All Day Long. Ree shows recipes that are quick to make. On the menu is French toast with maple cream, grilled chicken and strawberry wraps and Philly cheesesteaks. S8, Ep1

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Takeout At Home. Ree cooks up a Chinese-inspired menu for the girls. She makes delicious cream cheese wontons, sticky orange chicken, beef with broccoli and stir-fried chow mein. S8, Ep2

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Engagement Dinner. Ree throws an engagement party for a friend. On the menu are Brie-stuffed mushrooms, bacon-wrapped shrimp with chilli butter plus prime rib and Horseradish. S8, Ep3

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Going, Going, Gone. For charity Ina auctioned off a special lunch made by her. Using local ingredients, she makes a meal for two of Asian grilled salmon with a crunchy noodle salad. S8, Ep3

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Breakfast, Lunch And Dinner. Ina tests out some classic comfort food recipes on her work colleagues. She cooks them strawberry scones, a mushroom lasagne and a simple shrimp bisque. S8, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Tarts. The remaining bakers must use some unusual flavour combinations in their tartes tatin. Featuring artisan baker Paul Hollywood and the doyenne of baking, Mary Berry. S3, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Desserts. Amateur bakers make an array of decadently rich tortes and a crème caramel, under the watchful eyes of judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood. But who will triumph? S3, Ep4

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel visits a family-run vineyard to get an important ingredient for his monkfish dish. Plus, he reveals his simple recipe for pate grand-mere. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: What Grows Together Goes Together. Nigel cooks a delicious grilled lamb with feta and lemon. Plus, he makes Scottish raspberries with toasted oats and cream. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Made For Each Other. Nigel whips up a delicious dish with sausage and a creamy mustard sauce. Plus, he makes a tasty meal using green beans, ham and cheese. S1, Ep4

programme.desc: Coverage of the first quarter-final (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at Boston Stadium in the USA. Croatia and Brazil faced each other in the corresponding match in Qatar four years ago, with the former being indebted to their goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic as they booked their place in the semi-finals. Despite the game being goalless at the end of 90 minutes, Brazil were the dominant side for much of the contest and forced Livakovic into 11 saves to keep his side in the contest, and it was Neymar who finally broke the deadlock in stoppage time of the first half of extra-time, as he netted his 77th goal in international football. Croatia didn't manage to register a shot on target of their own until the final three minutes of extra time when Bruno Petkovic equalised via a shot deflected off the leg of Brazilian defender Marquinhos. When the contest turned to penalties to decide the outcome, Livakovic came to the rescue once again, saving the spot kick of Rodrygo, before the unfortunate Marquinhos hit the post, while Croatia scored all four of their attempts to progress

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the first quarter-final (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at Boston Stadium in the USA. Croatia and Brazil faced each other in the corresponding match in Qatar four years ago, with the former being indebted to their goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic as they booked their place in the semi-finals. Despite the game being goalless at the end of 90 minutes, Brazil were the dominant side for much of the contest and forced Livakovic into 11 saves to keep his side in the contest, and it was Neymar who finally broke the deadlock in stoppage time of the first half of extra-time, as he netted his 77th goal in international football. Croatia didn't manage to register a shot on target of their own until the final three minutes of extra time when Bruno Petkovic equalised via a shot deflected off the leg of Brazilian defender Marquinhos. When the contest turned to penalties to decide the outcome, Livakovic came to the rescue once again, saving the spot kick of Rodrygo, before the unfortunate Marquinhos hit the post, while Croatia scored all four of their attempts to progress

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the first quarter-final (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at Boston Stadium in the USA. Croatia and Brazil faced each other in the corresponding match in Qatar four years ago, with the former being indebted to their goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic as they booked their place in the semi-finals. Despite the game being goalless at the end of 90 minutes, Brazil were the dominant side for much of the contest and forced Livakovic into 11 saves to keep his side in the contest, and it was Neymar who finally broke the deadlock in stoppage time of the first half of extra-time, as he netted his 77th goal in international football. Croatia didn't manage to register a shot on target of their own until the final three minutes of extra time when Bruno Petkovic equalised via a shot deflected off the leg of Brazilian defender Marquinhos. When the contest turned to penalties to decide the outcome, Livakovic came to the rescue once again, saving the spot kick of Rodrygo, before the unfortunate Marquinhos hit the post, while Croatia scored all four of their attempts to progress

programme.desc: Coverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the first quarter-final (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at Boston Stadium in the USA. Croatia and Brazil faced each other in the corresponding match in Qatar four years ago, with the former being indebted to their goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic as they booked their place in the semi-finals. Despite the game being goalless at the end of 90 minutes, Brazil were the dominant side for much of the contest and forced Livakovic into 11 saves to keep his side in the contest, and it was Neymar who finally broke the deadlock in stoppage time of the first half of extra-time, as he netted his 77th goal in international football. Croatia didn't manage to register a shot on target of their own until the final three minutes of extra time when Bruno Petkovic equalised via a shot deflected off the leg of Brazilian defender Marquinhos. When the contest turned to penalties to decide the outcome, Livakovic came to the rescue once again, saving the spot kick of Rodrygo, before the unfortunate Marquinhos hit the post, while Croatia scored all four of their attempts to progress

programme.title: That Summer!
programme.desc: 1979. Drama. Director: Harley Cokeliss. Stars Ray Winstone, Julie Shipley & Tony London. A teenager gets out of reform school and heads to Torquay for a seaside holiday with three friends.

programme.title: Across The Bridge
programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Ken Annakin. Stars Rod Steiger, David Knight & Bernard Lee. An unscrupulous financier absconds to Mexico in an attempt to avoid capture for embezzlement.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Human Time Bomb. 1971. Stars Jean Trend, Roddy McMillan & Patrick Godfrey. Dr Fay Chantry performs a biological study of tower block life - and finds far more than she expected.

programme.title: Shadows on the Stairs
programme.desc: 1941. Crime. Director: D. Ross Lederman. Stars Frieda Inescort & Paul Cavanagh. Occupants of a boarding house become suspects after a string of murders.

programme.title: A Day Begins in Manchester (1960s)
programme.desc: Warming Glimpses of Manchester 'waking up'. From the streets to the factories and the docks and everything in between.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1964. Who Killed Who IV? Directed by Don Weis. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Burke's old flame is a suspect for the murder of Socialite equestrian William Henry Otis IV.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. Fringe Benefits. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen.

programme.title: I Lived With You
programme.desc: 1933. Drama. Stars: Ursula Jeans, Ida Lupino & Minnie Rayner. A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Gladys who takes him home to live with her folks. Co-written by Ivor Novello.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Take a step back in time and enjoy the hit 60s tune Runaround Sue by Dion.

programme.title: You Pay Your Money
programme.desc: 1957. Crime Drama. A rogue smuggler enters a murky world when his wife is kidnapped. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Hugh McDermott, Jane Hylton and Honor Blackman.

programme.title: Hindle Wakes
programme.desc: 1952. Drama starring Leslie Dwyer and Lisa Daniely. Successful remake of one of the earliest British talkies. Set in the Hindle, two mill workers take off to Blackpool for the 'Wakes' holiday.

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Lucy and the Ring-a-Ding-Ring. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Mary Jane Croft. Mr Mooney has an expensive ring made for his wife but it looks like he won't be able to gift it to her...

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Harry Keller. Stars Don Taylor, Randy Stuart & Paul Dubov. A man begins to question the death of his first wife shortly after he gets remarried.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Unsung Heroes. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Marjie Lawrence & Deborah Watling. Ash tackles a bomb, it's not considered vital, but the new fuse extractor doesn't work.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: The Rivals. 1963. Directed by Max Varnel. Stars Jack Gwillim, Erica Rogers & Brian Smith. Millionaire Swedish industrialist Rolf Neilson is horrified when his daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Brothers. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Alexander Guage. A poor young serf is helped into a monastery by Robin and Friar Tuck but flees when he discovers his brother is in prison.

programme.title: Two Way Stretch
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Directed by Robert Day. Stars Peter Sellers, David Lodge & Bernard Cribbins. Dodger Lane intends to break out of prison, steal a fortune in diamonds, and break back into prison.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: The Mighty Warrior. 1962. Stars John Ireland & John Scott. A champion steeplechase horse falls and dies during a race, costing Eastern Insurance £20,000. Hunter is sent to investigate the stables.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: The Night They Hit No.8. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas, Shelagh Fraser & Julie Goodyear. During a night of intense bombing the Ashton children are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: Double Jeopardy. 1989. Stars Robert Powell, Cathryn Harrison & Nigel Le Vaillant. When Hannay is entrusted with a dozen diamonds, he little knows the danger and distress they will bring.

programme.title: Z-Cars
